reviews.comment: She is very accommodating. She cares about her students. Attendance was said to be required, but there was no penalty for missing class. The coursework itself is very easy and not very time consuming. However, the group project counts for A LOT of your grade, and is what changed my A to a B.

Sara was soooo laid back and genuine. This reflected in the awesome group discussions we were able to have in class. She created an awesome environment with students in mind and it was a super awesome course!! Highly recommend!

Professor Rowe does not teach any material. Lectures consist of watching a video or doing some middle school level activity. She forgot to give us an outline for our second speech despite being constantly reminded. This class feels like it is her last priority. Speech grades are dependent solely on your TA, so you better hope you get a nice one.

She was very easygoing, understanding, and made our class super fun and engaging. I'm not usually one to speak up in class, but she created a comfortable environment for that and I discussed a lot. We made our own syllabus, so it was a little disorganized at times, but she always made sure to let us know what was expected of us. Highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was a NIGHTMARE. Speeches are graded on a weird rubric that is extremely subjective and difficult understand. The quality of this class greatly depends on who your section instructor is (mine was awful and didn't get grades in until the very end of the semester.) If I had a different section instructor the class would have been better.

I used spent years competing in (and winning) speech competitions in my state and this class still was a struggle for me. She has certain criteria for her speeches like specific outlines/formats your speeches have to fit or else you will be marked down. Once took my section professor over a month to get a grade back for a speech.

This professor has an inflated view of the importance of her own class. Lecture att. is taken despite lack of useful material. Speeches (exam grades) are graded on formatting rules of a written outline rather than primarily on the actual spoken speech. The speeches themselves demand "masterful" performance to get an A. Get another prof if possible.
I didn't like Rowes lectures. Recitation was more worth it to me. They are super strict graders. My TA wasn't has harsh thankfully. The grading criteia is complicated and sometimes unclear

Sara is awesome I loved taking her 443 class. She is super sweet and very easy to work with. There are few assignments but she is a fair grader. Be prepared to talk in class, but the class is small and discussions are super interesting

There are pointless 8am lectures that never really teach you anything, but attendance is mandatory. She never really taught how to speak, but just how to write a speech. This class is very pointless and did not help my public speaking at all. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

This professor is very disorganized and makes it hard to understand what she expects of us in our assignments. The lectures are awful and pointless since she teaches nothing. This class was supposed to teach you how to public speak, but it simply did not. This course is awful and I do not recommend taking this course.
you dont learn anything in the lectures and recitation and attendance is mandatory. the majority of the grade is dependent on speeches, which can easily become an issue with a lack of time.

I took public speaking, however she doesn't teach you how to public speak at all. This class teaches you to write a speech and do research, basically acting like an English class. We are judged throughout the class on the ability we already have. We go over nothing of actual delivery, or how to stay calm. I LEARNED NOTHING IN THIS CLASS.

Prof. Rowe seems like a nice person and gives fun lectures but is very disorganized. She has not graded anything since September and it is now almost December. This makes it annoying when you have to turn in assignments while not knowing what you need to improve on. While she seems like a nice person, I will not be taking her again for this reason
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you get a good TA you'll love the class, and I liked Mrs. Rowe also! Speeches were difficult but not overly so, and as long as you put effort in you'll get a B. The group project is the 'final exam' but really isn't anything different than other speeches. Class is mandatory and a big part of your grade, but is otherwise useless to go to.

In no way is this course difficult, easier than some high school classes I took. Professor Rowe is kind and understanding. She makes quizzes based on the textbook chapter vocab words, group projects, and experiments, as well as two exams. Grading is a little slow but not really a big deal. Overall easy class and good professor.

Overall Prof. Rowe makes this class is very fun, engaging, and interesting; however, it is by no means an easy class. Quizzes and Test (while online) can be very difficult so make sure to still study. She also has us do experiments where she is a tough grader. I am a little concerned because she also takes awhile getting grades back. Not a blow off

All the quiz material comes straight from the textbook, so as long as you read that you'll be fine. For the weekly experiments, she wants you to use vocabulary from the textbook, so if you don't you won't do well. I feel like that's pretty straightforward, and people didn't do well because they didn't put in a lot of effort. Overall a good prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Don't take her, you'll regret it. Worst communication and most disorganized class I've ever seen. She is an extremely tough grader but gives very vague and confusing instructions so she's impossible to please. She's also weeks behind in grading. And don't try to reach her either because she doesn't check emails outside of M-F 9-5.

Do NOT take her. She is way too hard on grading. I read the chapters, I did my homework, was at every class & still got 60s/50s on assignments because she is so damn unclear about what to do yet has a specific way she likes every little thing done. I regret taking her. I was at a 4.0 until her terrible class. She shouldn't call herself a teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Unfortunately, this professor was not present for any of the class. I went to office hours once at the beginning of this class and other than that she has been MIA since. The class is over in two days and I don't have a single grade for any of the speeches I have done, and I have submitted 5.

Professor Rowe was the worst. Very unorganized, and didn't really care about people's progress in class. The TA's are the ones who grade your speeches and work so you have to kiss their butt to get anything. I thought my first speech went incredible and i got a 77 on it. Not one person that i talked to got an A on any given speech. Do NOT take ROWE

Dr. Rowe is very nice, and I feel like she cares about her students. However, I didn't like the structure of this class. It was very discussion-based which I didn't really get much out of, and I don't feel like the lectures or discussions really prepared me for the test. This style may be better for other students or for an in-person course though.

Prof. Rowe herself is pretty lovable, but this is essentially a TA-graded course. My TA pretty much expected perfection for an A (so almost nobody gets one and lots fail). Even with lots of effort, it feels impossible to make an A. Assignments are easy, and speeches are most of the grade. Instructions are often unclear, so talk them out with TA.

Honestly for a communications class the teacher/ student communications is insanely bad. Almost no one in the class had a clue when assignments were due or even what specifically was expected on the assignments. Also the class is super unorganized.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was a bit disorganized and often had instructions for a project on 5 different pages, so I was pretty unclear about everything she wanted most of the time. Other than that, she's nice and gives good feedback. Other than the main speeches, everything else was pretty much an easy A. Probably better without COVID because of the organization issues

She is the worst speech professor. Anything you turn in she doesn't like, it is very hard to please her. Take anyone else but her. Nothing is ever good for her and she always has something to say. Her speeches are unclear on what she wants and is the worst grader. Even if you show up to office hours she is no help. I could go on and on about her

It makes it extremely difficult to do well in this class considering she grades the speeches based on her personal values. If she doesnt agree with your position on a speech, expect to fail. Doesn't teach, just gives useless assignments. Wouldnt recommend to anyone. I think A&M is just hiring anyone who wants to work there at this point. Shame on U

Definitely take Sara if you have the option. Her class is pretty laid back besides the 4 major speeches, but you just have to manage your time wisely. She gives great feedback on the topic for your speech before it is due, so if she doesn't think it is great, she will let you know in enough time to change it up. She is easy to get ahold of as well.

Do not take this class with her. She is a tough grader. It's extremely easy to get a D on projects. If you're looking for feedback expect it the next week or not at all. If she does get back to you she will often just say look in the book. If you have Aylsuss Hooks as your GA expect some difficulty. It's unnecessarily difficult. Try it elsewhere.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Grading criteria is in your favor where as the first speech is worth the least so there's only room to improve. TA and her are there to help, obviously no exams, 4 speeches and everything you learn is helpful in the real world plus it builds on another.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend for an online class. Between not being able to get in touch with her, giving a rubric but little feedback on your speech, and giving 4 assignments a week, this class is harder than it should be. She will fail your speech for not standing in the video; something that would not be an issue during an in-person class. 0 empathy
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall a solid choice for a prof! She has trouble responding to emails which was understandable with the online transition. We had weekly quizzes, packback discussion posts, and a group project. She took away the quizzes though once we moved online. Sweet woman!

A really great professor in my opinion. She is extremely caring and understanding of people and her class is very interesting. If you like a laid back structure then this class is for you! I loved her I would definitely take her again if I wasn't graduating.

I really liked professor Rowe. I think she graded pretty easy, and the only time I needed the textbook was before the weekly quiz. I would highly recommend her for 315. She's very forgiving and you'll likely get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The material of this class was really interesting! It just sucked having absolutely no structure. You are kind of left to figure the class out for yourself, especially with the project. Professor Rowe is extremely nice, but took forever to respond to emails. Grades were posted late so most of the time you are unsure where you stood
Her big lecture classes weren't very helpful, but she would randomly take attendance. Use your TA's office hours to pass this class. Plan ahead and stay ahead!! This class is as hard as you make it.

I highly encourage going to office hours for help in writing a speech as she helped me organized my thoughts and feel better prepared to give my speech. that being said, I find the class hard for people who are not naturally good at public speaking like myself. It seemed that I had to work much harder to receive a decent grade while others didn't.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Sara is a true gem! I was very skeptical at the beginning of the semester bc she is very free spirited w/ how class is ran. However, she knew what she was doing and I truly learned so much from her and the way she taught us. She is very sweet and kind. Highly recommend her!

Sara has been my favorite prof to date. She really cares about her students and will go above and beyond to help you with her class AND personal issues. She is very understanding, and never counted off points when I turned in something late(just talk to her b4) Only downside is we are already in finals weeks and have nothing major in grade book
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Super kind. Makes the class so interesting.

Rowe is nice and helpful if you go to office hours which I did and got As on every paper, I think we had to write like 7 over the course of the semester. Overall class is easy, class discussions that you have to go to. I never read the textbook and did fine but she takes forever to grade. beware she told me she never gives A+ on papers
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Loved her! Truly cares about every student and wants to know you personally. Took her for an interviewing class and bull crapped my way through to get an A. I never actually did the interviews or read the book. The only thing I don't like about this prof is that she's not reliable with grades. It's finals week and some of the big grades aren't in.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Great Prof! Very fun and hip! Be ready to put in work. When she lectures make sure you take notes because they may be on a quiz. A fun subject to learn so make sure you pay attention, it can help you in the future.

I genuinely learned how to develop good communication skills in this class. Though there were four speeches required throughout the course, the class was small & preparing & delivering the speeches certainly helped me get better. You have to really earn your grade in this class, however. No textbook is required; She gives you access to free PDF's.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is so nice in class and very helpful in office hours. The speeches are graded pretty toughly. There are 5 essays, no exams, and quizzes every Friday. As long as you put in effort you will get an A on the essays and quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: okay prof, okay class, problem is grading, class is set up for a B, you have to really "wow" her to get an A speech and even that isn't a 100, when you get "good" speech its a B (around 84) which is fine but if you want an A it builds up and its really hard at the end. good thing is final is a test so its possible to get a 100 on that.

I would stay away from this lecturer if you can. She doesn't grade fairly and she's boring. Go to her office and maybe you can convince her to give you a better grade but when she tells you why she gave you a grade, she doesn't make any sense. She also doesn't round an 89.9. Go figure.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great person, fun to relate to, but her grading isn't good, she's very nice, will tell you what to do, and if you do it, thats considered a good speech which is an 85. You have to "wow" her to get an A and its near-impossible to do so. After speeches if you confront her about speech grade, she uses "I didn't get wow factor" to justify deductions
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Rowe is a quirky, Zooey Deschanel type professor. She made the class fun, and I truly learned a ton. If you want to actually learn how to write speeches, take Rowe. If you want an easy A however, take someone else, because Rowe makes you work for it. She takes a long time to grade, but she gives great feedback & will help you improve.

She is a very nice person, teaches well, but her baseline grading is not good, it is impossible to get a 100 on something, if you get a "perfect" or A+, it's like a 92, to get an A is very hard, she consistently gives around 82's for speeches, if your goal is a B take her, it's easy for a B if your goal is an A stay away, it's near impossible.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Wouldn't recommend this professor. I didn't start getting grades for assignments I turned in in the first month until after Q-drop day. She's very nice and cares about the students, her grading just needs to be addressed. If you care about the course more than the grade take her, but if its vice versa then chose another professor
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sara was an amazing person! I loved her class and I am not someone who enjoys speaking in public at all! You DEFINITELY have to work for your grades, I never made an A on a speech, but i was always close! I ended .17 away from an A so it is do-able even without getting A's on the speeches! YOU HAVE TO GO TO CLASS or you will not pass!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She clearly outlines the semester calendar for her class at the beginning of the semester and gives you all the resources you need. She is funny and works to relate to students. Be wary of the different grading weights on speeches-- my worst grade was on the heaviest one and I missed an A by .31 points. Talk to her for help!
She's a really tough grader, and makes it hard to get an A but she is a really nice teacher and person in general!

she's a nice person and easy to relate to, however her grading system is very inconsistent and she makes it extremely hard to get an A.  If you're looking for a B you can take her but still expect to work, however if you're looking for an A, STAY AWAY FROM HER, she will not give out A's to anyone

Sara is an AMAZING teacher! She is very approachable and kind and makes the environment for speeches relaxed, which helps a nervous person like myself! I would love to take another class with her because I genuinely enjoyed her presence! You have to work hard on your speeches and be present in class to do well,  but overall this class is great!

Ms. Rowe is an awesome professor. Super sweet and funny. I had her for an 8am so she always had ways to wake us up. You HAVE to work hard to get a good grade. She is a tough grader. If you put effort into your speeches, you'll do just fine.

She is an overall nice person and good professor, but a really tough grader. You have to work really hard on your speeches. I worked my butt off, and it was definitely my most stressful class. I am also a comm major so I am a pretty decent speaker, but I still only received a B (I swear I haven't met a person who made an A in COMM 203).

I went to her office hours, and that's where she offers the most help. Class gets out early most of the time, and she's honestly one of the sweetest people ever. She's really relatable and understands if you are struggling! You do have to work hard on your speeches, but the speech environment is super chill because everyone is  in the same boat!

I would recommend her, however she is a very tough grader when it comes to speeches and reports. In class lectures can be very confusing and as a student you have to keep up with assignments because they overflow into one another which gets confusing.
She was awesome! I would definitely take ger again. She is kind, laid back and if you actually put effort in your speeches you'll make an A.
She was by far one of the worst professors I've ever taken.

DO NOT TAKE HER!  She grades way to hard on speeches and expect you to be the worlds greatest speaker on the first speech.  Lectures are sometimes confusing and scattered out, you don't know what to write down. The quizzes are pretty simple if you do the study guide but that's the only thing easy in this class. this class shouldn't be this hard.

She's a great teacher. We had three speeches and then a written exam. She is a hard grader but gives good feedback and if you put in effort and prepare well she will reward you! Going in to office hours is helpful, she is nice and approachable. She makes class fun and pretty interesting and she's very laid back.  I would take her again.
This is an easy class. She is very sweet and helpful. There are a few homework and quizzes. She offers extra credit activities.
Not a good teacher at all, does everything from power point and goes way too fast.  Quizzes and homework make no sense.  Grades very hard on speeches.
Bad teacher. She reads of off powerpoints the whole time and tends to be boring. Grades your speeches real hard. Unprepared for tests and does not give reviews. DONT TAKE HER!
She is awesome, not much more to be said
Sara is the most awesome teacher ever! I would love to take another class with her. She changed my life.
